vault_lines: Yeah, this shit ain't come overnight
meaning:
808 Mafia is the popular tag of producer Southside, who is best known for having worked with artists such as Kodak Black, 21 Savage, and Kanye West.



Pictured: Southside

808 Mafia is also the production label founded by Southside himself and Lex Luger in 2010 and is parented by Bricksquad Monopoly.

“Blood Sweat & Tears” marks the third official track Southside has worked on with Babyface Ray, following “6 Mile Show” and “Get in Dere” (with Doe Boy).
